desc: Write a brute-force solver to compute game outcomes for all small N (up to 5) and A_i (up to 4) using memoized recursion.
Run the brute-force and record the winning conditions for all cases into a table.
Deduce the exact pattern from the brute-force results (likely: Fennec wins iff max(A) > sum(A) - max(A), but with parity tie-breaking for N).
Implement the final solution based on the deduced pattern.
Verify the solution against all sample inputs and the brute-force results.
